dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY includes with .INC extension, CALL to ORCA-specific subprograms, and shell script invocation patterns typical of the ORCA open-source medical billing system
evidence: EXEC SQL absent, EXEC CICS absent

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (teiki seikyuu - periodic/regular claims processing) within the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software system
purpose.summary: This program (ORCGO01) handles periodic medical insurance claim creation (Teiki Seikyuu) in the JMA ORCA system. It manages screen navigation, SPA (scratchpad area) initialization, date conversion, and invokes shell scripts for monthly claim batch processing. It coordinates between multiple screens (O01, O02, O03, O99, OID1, OID2) and interacts with job management and system master databases.

notable_features: 18 CALL statements to ORCA subprograms (e.g. ORCSGDAY)
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA/SPAAREA/LINKAREA (ORCA window manager pattern)
Japanese-encoded comments (EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for screen event handling
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS despite DB access (uses MCP abstraction layer)
verdict.notes: Comments are in Japanese EUC-JP encoding, displayed as mojibake due to latin-1 decoding. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. The MCP (Medical Care Platform) abstraction replaces direct CICS calls; program_type is set to online-cics as the closest match for this interactive window-based program. Source truncated at 16000 chars but sufficient evidence present.
